nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Soil health management|Soil structure improvement_qna_000
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How is particulated organic matter (POM) distributed within the soil matrix?
nodes.answer: POM can be thoroughly mixed into the wet soil matrix or mainly located in air-filled macropores, depending on soil structure formation.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Soil health management|Soil structure improvement_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What role do roots play in the distribution of POM in the soil?
nodes.answer: Roots grow into larger pores or produce their own biopores, resulting in POM fragments typically being located near air-filled macropores.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Soil health management|Soil structure improvement_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How is the distribution of air-filled pore space in soil determined?
nodes.answer: The distribution patterns of air-filled pores and organic residues are determined by soil structure, influenced by biotic processes, abiotic processes, or technical processes.
